messages:
Leah: Hey team — LuminaAI (org: lumina-prod) just opened a request for a temporary quota increase: they want 5x token rate for this weekend to demo to investors. They say it’s timeboxed to 48h. Can we triage?
Nick: @Leah thanks — can you paste the org id + API key owner? Also need last 24h usage and recent billing status. If payments look clean and no pattern of abuse, we can consider a temporary uplift with monitoring.
Leah: Org id: org_01G7LZK, API key owner: maria@lumina.ai. Quick usage snippet: approx 3M tokens/day last 3 days, spike to 6M in last 2 hours. Billing: card on file, invoices paid.
ops-bot: Fraud scan started for org_01G7LZK — score: 12/100 (low risk). Flag: multiple new API keys rotated in last 24h.
Nick: Low risk score is good, but key rotation is suspicious. Can we get a short explanation from the customer on why keys rotated? Also request a signed PO or MSA for increased committed billing before we allow production-level increases.
Ellie: Sales confirms Lumina is on a trial-to-paid cadence; they’re willing to sign a short addendum and prepay for the demo window. They want an answer today — investor meeting Monday.
Sam: From product side — permanent quotas live in backlog for per-customer dynamic caps (we want to automate this), but short-term we should handle manually. Proposal: grant a staged temporary uplift: 2x now for immediate relief, then allow 5x for 24h after we validate traffic patterns. Require monitoring alert and auto-revert after 48h.
Leah: Proposed operational checklist: 1) Verify billing + PO (Ellie); 2) Ask customer to explain key rotation and provide contact (Leah); 3) Temporary staged uplift config + guardrails (Nick/ops); 4) Create incident-tracking ticket and tag product for backlog item (Sam).
Nick: Guardrails: set a per-minute cap to prevent burst abuse, enable full request logging, and add anomaly detection alert if token/sec > 2x baseline for more than 10 minutes. Also attach request_id and ip info export for postmortem.
Leah: I'll ask customer for key rotation rationale and contact. Ellie can you secure the PO and MSA addendum?
Ellie: On it. I’ll get legal + finance signoff and upload the PO before EOD PST.
ops-bot: Uplift runbook: to apply temporary uplift run: ``/apply-uplift --org org_01G7LZK --factor 2 --duration 48h --guard "rate:per_minute=3000"``. Only ops oncall or Nick can execute.
Nick: I'll take the uplift action once PO is in and Leah confirms key rotation explanation. I'll also watch logs and be ready to rollback.
Sam: For product backlog: create a short spec ticket titled "dynamic customer caps (business-driven)" with acceptance criteria: automated risk checks, PO binding, staged rollout, and audit/logging. Assign to infra-sre and product-ops. This will be priority-low but include a launch stub so we don't repeat manual work.
Leah: Summary: temporary staged uplift path agreed, pending PO + customer confirmation. Owners: Ellie (PO), Leah (customer confirmation), Nick (ops + fraud watch), Sam (create backlog ticket). Expected decision timeline: uplift decision within 3h after PO arrives.
Ellie: :thumbsup: I'll update thread when PO uploaded.
Leah: Thanks — I'll ping again when customer responds to key rotation question.
Nick: If anything odd shows in logs, we revert immediately and escalate to security.
Sam: I'll open the backlog ticket now and link it here.
Leah: Closing loop for now — moving to support queue and tagging ops for execution once PO confirmed.
